body: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent pixel-art game sprite proposal sheet, one character with four complete coherent poses. Input image: the approved Grimhald axe-warden concept is the identity/style reference. Primary request: redraw him about 15 percent LESS WIDE in the shoulders and torso, same standing body height and helmet, dark iron armour, crimson cloth, ember orange eyes. Original simple blocky low-resolution sprite style, strong outline, restrained flat shading. Produce a clean 2x2 grid with generous transparent separation: top-left full-body connected standing pose carrying the crescent axe with the right gauntlet visibly gripping the wooden handle; top-right full-body RUN pose with a real bent lead knee and trailing leg and moving arms, axe supported on shoulder; bottom-left full-body connected low shoulder-first HEADBUTT charge pose, body leaning forward with bent knees, axe kept behind the back; bottom-right full-body UNARMED standing pose, both arms attached and hands empty, no axe or wood or weapon anywhere in this cell. Every cell is a whole character from crown to boots, legs anatomically connected to waist, no separated parts, no cutout-paper rig, no duplicated pieces. Same character, scale and face direction (three-quarter right) in all four cells. Keep stock-game melee proportions and about 39 logical pixels visible body height; display enlarged clean pixel clusters, no dithering, no painterly gradients. Keep original crescent axe identity and dark full helmet. No text, no labels, no decorative borders. Actual transparent background. Do not make him taller or wide like a superdeformed tank.
effects: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent pixel-art skill VFX sheet for Grimhald, dark iron/crimson/ember-orange axe warden. Create a clean 2x2 grid of four isolated effects with generous transparent spacing, no character bodies, no text. TOP LEFT: a directional advancing ground rupture, a jagged charcoal basalt fissure opening to the right with a narrow molten orange core and pushed-up stone plates, long and slender; original adaptation of a volcanic ground-crack attack. TOP RIGHT: a basalt pillar erupting from the end of the fissure, heavy angular dark rock, orange magma cracks, a low ring of dust and a few rising stone shards; strong readable silhouette, not a building. BOTTOM LEFT: a low forward-facing headbutt/shoulder-charge pressure fan moving right, compact grey-white pressure lines and foot dust, no creature, no axe, no fireball. BOTTOM RIGHT: a wall-collision impact of sharp stone shards, compressed white-grey force arc and small orange accents, one compact burst. Simple blocky game pixel art, 2-3 flat shades per material, sharp dark outline, no soft glow haze, no dithering. Match a 39-logical-pixel-tall melee champion; effects intended to be extracted down to roughly 24-80 logical pixels. Transparent background. Keep all four effects wholly inside their cells. Do not copy League of Legends artwork; create original materials and silhouettes.
method: Built-in imagegen; frozen sources; deterministic extraction and packing. Current revised proposals awaiting approval.
